notes.title: 🏴‍☠️ Miss Neko: Pirates Sets Sail Today! 🏴‍☠️
notes.content:
Ahoy, Captains!

The wait is over – Miss Neko: Pirates is officially available today! Embark on an exhilarating voyage in this 2D bullet-hell shooter set amidst the high seas.

As the captain of the "Lucky Coin," you've faced betrayal and perilous encounters, but now is the time to reclaim what's rightfully yours! With your crew of adorable beastly girls and mysterious, seductive foes, what daring escapades await you in this maritime adventure?

Set sail now to embark on this thrilling journey! Captains, hoist the sails and dive into the action today! ⚓️🌊🔥

notes.title: 🏴‍☠️ Miss Neko: Pirates Sets Sail on March 22nd! 🏴‍☠️
notes.content:
Ahoy, Captains!

Prepare yourselves for a thrilling voyage as Miss Neko: Pirates makes its grand debut on March 22nd! Get ready to embark on a swashbuckling adventure in this 2D bullet-hell shooter set in the high seas.

As the captain of the "Lucky Coin", you've been deceived and betrayed by your crew, narrowly escaping with your life. But fear not, it's time to reclaim what's rightfully yours! With a crew of adorable beastly girls and mysterious, seductive foes, what daring escapades await you in this tale of high-octane excitement?

Join us on the high seas and add Miss Neko: Pirates to your wishlist now! Captains, mark your calendars—March 22nd awaits! ⚓🌊🔥

notes.title: 🎄 Meowy Christmas, Darling Companions! 🎄
notes.content:
🎄 Meowy Christmas, Darling Companions! 🎄

Guess what's bringing joy to my fuzzy heart on this festive day? The pawsitively thrilling news about "Miss Neko: Pirates" sailing into your gaming world next spring, 2024! 🚢✨

Imagine the high seas, pirate neko cuties, and an adventure that'll make your whiskers twitch with excitement! Each cat girl brings her unique charm to the crew, and we've got a treasure trove of stories and surprises awaiting you.

So, here's my holiday wish: Add "Miss Neko: Pirates" to your wishlist now! Let's make spring 2024 a season of epic catventures. Meowtiful holidays to you all! 🐾💖
